subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate idiom for the underlined words in the given sentence.**

The candidate blamed the persistent traffic jam as reason of his being late and the interviewer __believed him though he was not convinced.__

options.text: thought err is human and to forgive is divine
did not judge the book by its cover

solution:
The correct answer is: **gave the benefit of doubt **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom "**gave the benefit of doubt**" means to accept someone's statement or explanation as true, even though there may be some doubt or uncertainty about its accuracy. (किसी के कथन या स्पष्टीकरण को सत्य मानना, भले ही उसकी सटीकता के बारे में कुछ संदेह या अनिश्चितता हो)
 
• It involves trusting or believing in someone's innocence or good intentions when there is ambiguity or lack of clear evidence.
 
 
• **Example**: *Joy was late to the meeting, but her colleague gave her the benefit of the doubt, assuming that she might have faced unexpected traffic or other issues.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Changed his tune: **To alter one's opinion, attitude, or behaviour, often in response to a new situation or information. (किसी नई स्थिति या जानकारी के जवाब में अक्सर किसी की राय, दृष्टिकोण या व्यवहार को बदलना)
 
• **Thought err is human and to forgive is divine: **Recognizing that people make mistakes (to err is human) and choosing to forgive them is an act of great compassion and understanding (to forgive is divine). (यह पहचानना कि लोग गलतियाँ करते हैं और उन्हें क्षमा करना बड़ी करुणा और समझ का कार्य है)
 
• **Did not judge the book by its cover: **Refrained from forming an opinion about someone or something based solely on its outward appearance, recognizing the importance of looking beyond surface impressions. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु के बारे में केवल उसके बाहरी दिखावे के आधार पर कोई राय बनाने से बचना चाहिए)
